review_description: The staff were very good, particularly the lady back a the office getting things organised. We did have a slight problem with the installer using screws that were a bit too long and he managed to get the tips through the lining of the balcony roof. However this was fixed very quickly and without any hassles.My only issue is that the Ergon people seem to be taking a long time to change the meter over!

I chose the system that my neighbour had installed on his property in town.  He was very happy with it  and so thought I shall go with him.  Since then a family about 5 km. from me has also installed the same system which was recommended from another person. He was also happy.Since it was installed about ten days ago it has not stopped raining or drizzle.  So the test will come when it fines up.Thank you for your time, and was pleased with the information you gave me.
